turns.prompt_text: The GE Profile 4.8 cu. ft. Smart UltraFast Electric Washer Dryer Combo in Jade Green with Ventless Heat Pump Technology is sold at Home Depot, i have an old washer/drier currently hooked up, only a few years old. Do I need the Semi-Rigd Dryer Duct or the Dryer Power Cord?
turns.response_html:
Based on the specifications for the GE Profile UltraFast Washer Dryer Combo, you do not need to purchase a separate semi-rigid dryer duct or a dryer power cord.

Here is the breakdown of why these typical laundry accessories are not required for this specific model:

  • No Dryer Duct Needed: This unit uses Ventless Heat Pump Technology, meaning it does not exhaust hot, moist air outside. It recirculates air internally and drains moisture through the shared washer drain hose. You can actually seal off your old wall vent entirely.
  • Power Cord is Included: Unlike standard electric dryers that require a separate 240V cord, this combo unit plugs into a standard 120V household outlet (the same kind you use for a lamp or toaster). It comes with a factory-installed power cord approximately 66 inches long.

Installation Requirements

Since you are replacing an old setup, here is what you will need for a successful install:

  • 120V Dedicated Outlet: Ensure your outlet is a standard three-prong 120V outlet on a dedicated 15-amp circuit.
  • Standard Water Hookups: You will still need your existing hot and cold water faucets.
  • Drainage: The unit includes a drain hose that goes into your existing standpipe or laundry tub.

If you plan on installing this in a tight space like a closet, I can look up the specific clearance requirements and door ventilation needs for you. Would you like me to do that?
